title: Incolur
description: incolur.cl zoominfo.com/c/incolur/372497016 Incolur Corretajes Limitada is a Chilean import & distribution company specialized in industrial supplies. It imports and distributes: machine tools and their accessories, abrasives (grinding/cutting wheels), welding equipment, measuring & precision instruments, industrial gauges and tooling for workshops and construction. De facto it works as a B2B supplier, reselling international industrial brands to the Chilean market.
